summary.text: Katie Zolnikov is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 44, where Ballotpedia lists her tenure as beginning in 2021, and a business owner seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Mike Eaton.

paragraphs.text: Zolnikov's career experience includes co-owning and managing a business.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations Committee, the House Taxation Committee and the House Ethics Committee, which she chaired.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
